name: Why Natural (No Stain) Is the Most Popular Finish in Seattle Homes
title-tag: Why Natural (No Stain) Floors Win in Seattle Homes
meta-description: Why most Seattle floors we refinish go natural: $3.99 vs $6.50/sq ft, no blotch risk on fir and maple, more winter light, and a look that never dates.
post-summary: October 19, 2026 · Natural — a full sand under clear waterborne, no stain — is what most Seattle floors we refinish get, and for concrete reasons: $3.99/sq ft versus $6.50 stained, a shorter schedule, no blotch risk on fir or maple, and more light in gray-sky rooms. Plus the honest cases where we’ll recommend stain anyway.
